headline: Callahans Passage Erupts as Fishermans Row Settles Under One Flag
war_summary: Three hours past our last filing, the war's center of gravity has shifted. Callahans Passage, unmentioned in our previous edition, now tops the casualty columns: more than seven thousand losses to each side in a day, the hourly rate still climbing, and the day's flags all flying at Crumbling Post, which passed to Warden keeping before being reduced to no-man's-land. In Fishermans Row the lone Warden-held work has fallen, leaving all nine bases under Colonial colors after another busy day at Eidolo and Black Well. Stlican Shelf remains the liveliest field on the map, thirty-four flag events in the day and the last logged at this edition's very minute, with one work now counted as rubble. Weathered Expanse keeps up its dreadful exchange, thirty-nine events and the tally of works standing five Colonial to four Warden. Farranac Coast and Mooring County stay in motion about The Bone Haft and The Wind Hills. The Nevish Line storm and the Dead Lands, loud last edition, have gone silent. Day 275; no victor declared.
